fixer.summary: The grappler lookup now lives in two helpers in `dungdra/effects.py`, the bottom layer: `grapples_on(creature, by=None)` returns the Grappled conditions on a creature (optionally only those from one grappler) as a list, so callers can remove effects while looping. `grapplers_of(creature)` returns the set of grappler ids and carries the SRD[GLOSS.grappled#2] tag. All the old copies of the scan now use them: the Grappled condition's attack check in effects.py; the drag check (#3), `_after_move` and `release_grapple` in combat.py; and `on_incapacitated` in game.py. In `on_incapacitated` the grapple removal is now its own loop, separate from the `ends_if_caster_incapacitated` loop, so an effect already removed isn't looked at a second time. Behaviour is otherwise unchanged. `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` are clean, all 305 unit tests pass, the srd and scenario suites pass (266), and `python -m scripts.srdloop dev-gate` passes. The ticket names no acceptance tests, so there was nothing to run with `--runxfail`.

followups.title: escape_grapple (combat.py:1615) still finds its Grappled condition with its own `next(e for e in c.effects if e.condition == "grappled")` scan. Route it through grapples_on(c) so every grapple lookup uses the one helper
The grappled_by(target, grappler) test helper is defined three times (tests/unit/test_effects.py:13, test_combat.py:12, test_api.py:8). Move one copy into tests/support/helpers.py
